Replacing a missing tooth

Dental implants in Sète: assessment before treatment

An implant may support a crown or prosthesis, but suitability depends on oral tissues, general health, anatomy and the restorative plan.

Contact the practice
English

This is an informational translation. The practice has not confirmed that consultations can be conducted in English. Please contact the practice to arrange communication.

01

Assessment and alternatives

The discussion may include an implant, bridge, removable prosthesis or no immediate replacement, depending on the clinical situation.

02

Surgery and healing

Local anaesthesia is commonly used. The number of stages and healing time vary and cannot be guaranteed before assessment.

03

Maintenance

Daily hygiene, professional monitoring and management of risk factors remain important after treatment.
